A Grave Mistake#000.src: Thank you again for all of your help!

A Grave Mistake#002.src: But since you have made it thus far, I suppose I shall show you the truth...

A Grave Mistake#003.src: Then leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...

A Grave Mistake#004.src: Keep in mind what you have learned.

A Grave Mistake#006.src: There is nothing in this graveyard.
A Grave Mistake#006.dst: No hay nada en este cementerio.
A Grave Mistake#006.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#011.src: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
A Grave Mistake#011.dst: ¿Dónde es.. mi brazo.? Necesito mi br... Lo dejé en algún... ¿arriba?
A Grave Mistake#011.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#012.src: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
A Grave Mistake#012.dst: Se te advirtió que no entraras en este lugar olvidado.

A Grave Mistake#013.src: But since you made it thusfar, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
A Grave Mistake#013.dst: Pero ya que has llegado hasta aquí, supongo que te mostraré la verdad...

A Grave Mistake#015.src: Now leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
A Grave Mistake#015.dst: Ahora vete, y olvida los horrores que has presenciado hoy aquí...
A Grave Mistake#015.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#018.src: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
A Grave Mistake#018.dst: No tengo nada más que decir. Toma esto.
A Grave Mistake#018.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#019.src: Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
A Grave Mistake#019.dst: Ooh.. oh... otra víctima... Bienvenido... no hace falta presentarse... ... ahora tendrás el tiempo justo...
A Grave Mistake#019.speaker: Skull

A Grave Mistake#020.src: After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
A Grave Mistake#020.dst: Al fin y al cabo... acabas de caer en una tumba... pero pongámonos cómodos... ¡¿por dónde muerdo primero?!
A Grave Mistake#020.speaker: Skull
